packet_dag.terminal_condition: The public OneTime landing has a black/yellow header, black-on-white logo treatment, and email-only bottom signup strip; the Agent Review Hub has a focused workflow prompt and moves copied prompts into a running/dropoff-needed lane.

title: OneTime Public Signup Strip And Agent Workflow

reasons: The request changes the public landing page information architecture and lead capture form.
The request adds Agent Mode workflow prompts and copy/dropoff state tracking.
The request mentions WhatsApp and external workflow testing, which must remain guarded from live sends or external mutations.
likely_external_provider_blockers: No live WhatsApp/WAPI send is allowed until Rabbi WAPI credentials, class-link env, and explicit send approval are present.
Agent Mode may inspect and report WhatsApp readiness, but cannot send or mutate external provider state.
ramble_router.next_exact_packet: After this packet, run Agent Mode against the new public signup/WhatsApp workflow prompt and ingest the saved AGR result.

operator_intent_summary: The OneTime public landing should feel launch-ready: black/yellow scoped, compact, and clear. The top yellow announcement should become a bottom hero signup strip with only an email capture and Sign Up Now CTA. Agent Mode prompts should test this workflow and WhatsApp readiness, and copying a prompt should move it into a running/dropoff-needed section so the same prompt is not copied twice by mistake.
raw_quotes: capture on the bottom with the just email
that yellow bar should just be on the bottom before the next section
the top toolbar is black with like a yellow outline
the logo is black black on white
agent mode prompts to check to test those workflows
when I click copy ... it automatically moves it over to like the next section
out_of_scope: No WAPI credential storage or external-provider mutation.
No Stripe, payment, DNS, Zoom, Drive, or Vimeo write.
No broad redesign of provider, parent, student, member, or classroom portals.
affected_surfaces: OneTime public landing hero and signup strip
OneTime public interest API client payload
Agent Review Hub prompt card lane layout

inspection_targets: public/one-time/index.html header, announcement bar, ticker, and interest form
src/lib/bna/agent-review-hub.js prompt list and prompt workflow state
tests covering OneTime landing and Agent Review Hub
observed: The landing page currently has a top sticky yellow announcement and a separate multi-field form near the bottom.
The interest API validation already accepts email-only leads as long as one contact field is present.
The Agent Review Hub starts an in-progress AGR before copying but does not render a durable copied/running lane after copy.
known_blockers: Real WhatsApp send remains blocked by external credential/setup decisions.
Live synthetic form submission can create a first-party test lead and must be explicit in evidence.

trigger_phrases: drop it in the right place

expanded_phrases.just email: The public lead capture form should expose one visible email input and hidden first-party consent/source fields only.
expanded_phrases.sign up now: The primary public CTA copy should be Sign Up Now and should scroll/focus to the signup strip.
expanded_phrases.yellow bar on the bottom: The yellow promotional band belongs at the bottom of the hero before the next content section, not as a sticky top announcement.
expanded_phrases.toolbar black with yellow outline: The sticky header should be black, visually bounded by a yellow border/outline, and not reserve vertical space for the removed announcement.
expanded_phrases.perfect template: The Agent Mode prompt must include exact navigation, safe workflow boundaries, failure reporting, and dropoff/readback requirements.
expanded_phrases.drop it in the right place: The hub should group prompts by ready, running/dropoff-needed, and saved/repair states; copy should move the prompt into the running lane.
expanded_phrases.launch-ready: This packet defines launch readiness as scoped OneTime branding, one visible email field, first-party no-send/no-checkout/no-access persistence, mobile screenshots, Agent Mode prompt lane tracking, tests, deploy proof, and live smoke evidence.

requirements.statement: OneTime public signup and agent workflow testing must be launch-ready, scoped, and trackable.
requirements.expected_result: The public page shows an email-only yellow Sign Up Now strip at the bottom of the hero, the header is black with yellow outline and black-on-white logo treatment, the form posts only to first-party interest capture with no sends/charges/access grants, and Agent Review prompts can be copied, tracked, moved to running/dropoff-needed, and saved back through AGR dropoff.

criteria: Current OneTime landing and Agent Review Hub files were inspected.
Email-only lead backend validation was confirmed in src/lib/bna/one-time-product-system.js.
External sends remain explicitly out of scope.

Logo sits on a white tile and renders as dark/black artwork.
Signup strip is yellow, bottom of hero, before the next content section.
Email input and Sign Up Now button are aligned on desktop and stack cleanly on mobile.
Email input has a label or accessible name.
Button text is visible at mobile widths.
Prompt lane status is text-visible, not color-only.

action_states.label: Sign Up Now
action_states.handler_or_blocker: Browser anchor scroll to #start-free signup strip.

action_states.label: Submit email-only OneTime interest
action_states.expectation: Posts email-only payload to /api/one-time/interest and receives first-party no-send/no-checkout/no-access response.

action_states.label: Copy Agent Prompt
action_states.handler_or_blocker: copyPrompt starts audit through /api/bna/agent-review/prompts/start, copies the prompt, and marks local workflow state prompt_copied.

data_requirements.lead_policy: First-party interest lead only; no checkout, no external send, no access grant.
data_requirements.agent_review_policy: Prompt copy uses existing idempotency key and must save final PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED back to AGR.

security_privacy.public_page: Anonymous-safe and no private data exposure.
security_privacy.agent_mode: No credentials, tokens, screenshots with private data, external writes, sends, charges, or provider mutations.
security_privacy.test_data: Live form submit, if performed, must use clearly synthetic non-customer data and evidence must state that a first-party test lead was created.
